researcherGrade.basis: Level7 diploma estimate, hardest cello1. Actual p1 (I mm1–9): tenor-clef lead, chromatic articulated sixteenths and offbeat double-stop accompaniment. P9 (II mm1–7): exposed tenor-clef cantabile over repeated bass/inner-voice patterns. P20 (III mm9–16): treble-clef lead, triplets mixed with sixteenths, six-flat key signature and chromatic alterations. P25 (III mm47–53): extended rapid chromatic/sixteenth lead and 32nd-note figure, simultaneous lower-part accents; p26 confirms ensuing motif repetition and closing portamento. High-register agility, character shifts and syncopation support diploma demand; brief isolated fast figure is not treated as whole-work virtuosity. Ensemble coordination reinforces estimate without a separate full-level uplift.
